blurb: SoCal Vibes Co. operates a brewery and tasting rooms in Carson and Venice, offering craft ciders, meads, beers, and food. Guests can enjoy a beachy, chill atmosphere with live music and game nights. The company also hosts private events with tailored spaces and on-site catering.
